items.title: Bridges gone, roads damaged, villages cut off from relief
items.summary: Helicopters and temporary crossings are helping deliver food and other essentials to cut-off communities in Rasuwa and Nuwakot, but officials say restoring roads and bridges must be an immediate priority.

items.title: Five bodies found in flood-damaged Upper Trishuli-1 tunnel
items.summary: The discovery comes three weeks after devastating floods hit Rasuwa and left people missing inside the hydropower project.

items.title: Bouldin meets Shah, offers US support for Nepal’s disaster recovery
items.summary: The US chargé d’affaires expressed condolences over the Rasuwa floods as the prime minister called for greater global cooperation on climate-related risks.
